segments.text: The younger sister of Mirai. Ima specializes using a bow-and-arrow.
Mostly appears in Mare's Route in Eternal Heart.
She was sent back to Hibarigasaki in order to return Kosame to the stars, but after discovering both Ren and Mare, she decides to deal with them too.
Her memories have been wiped out and thus, she can't remember anything about her family or older brother. She is mentioned in the first game when her brother tells that she suddenly disappeared.
飛鳥未来の妹。
行方不明とされていたが、星天宮の巫女であったことが発覚する。
無口で無感情。性格的なものというより、自ら感情を押さえ込んでいる節がある。
雲雀ヶ崎出身ではあるが、記憶を失っているため、郷愁の念はない。
彼女が街に現れたのは、星霊であるこさめを送り還すという目的があったに過ぎない。
飛鳥未来的妹妹。
原本行踪不明，现在知道她成了星天宮的巫女。
不说话无無感情。与其说是性格，不如说是自己抑制感情的表达。
出生于雲雀ヶ崎，但因为丧失了记忆，所以没有乡愁。
Likes: Her brother
Dislikes: Temple grinding

Chinami is You's little sister. She tends to be bad at everything (especially in cooking; everything she tries to cook turns into charcoal), except driving her brother crazy. However, she has the ability to become friends with anyone due to her energetic personality and smile.

She is actually his half-sister but they share the same mother. Chinami thinks that her whole life, starting from her birth is just a burden and is also afraid that her dear Onii-chan will leave her just like their mother did. This is the reason for why she wants to take care of You so much.
洋の妹で、衣鈴の親友。
寝坊したり忘れ物をしたり、兄の洋よりもだらしないくせに面倒を見ようとするので失敗に終わってばかり。
だが基本的に何事にもめげないので、次の瞬間にはけろっとしていて拍子抜け。
洋にとってはかわいい妹であり、今では恋人の関係としてそばにいるようになっている。
ヒバリ校的1年生。洋的妹妹、衣鈴的同班同学。
拥有无论什么食材都能搞成黑炭的料理特技（？）。
容易睡模糊和忘记东西，比哥哥还要废柴却经常受人照顾，所以做事总是以失败告终。
平时已经喋喋不休了，哭的时候生气的时候就更是喋喋不休，让人手足无措。
但是因为性格不爱认输，所以很快又会制造另一个麻烦。
但是对洋来说，她是个很可爱的妹妹，一直都在暗地里守护着制造麻烦的她。
喜欢的事情：哥哥的照顾　讨厌的事情：哥哥的太阳穴攻击
「千波一直，都是哥哥的同伴噢」
Likes: Constellation myths
Dislikes: The Student Council

One of You's classmates from elementary school before he moved. She loves the stars very much, but always seems to have trouble with the Student Council. The vice-president of the astronomy club and You's class president. She is a maid waitress at the Milky Way, which is owned by her father.
She has liked You ever since childhood but has always hidden her feelings from him. Her other ear is also partially deaf.
進級し、ヒバリ校の３年生になっている。
現在は天クルの部長を務めている。
明るく元気なムードメーカー。
人と話すときに顔を近づけるクセがあり、今では洋の右隣を指定席にしている。
洋とつきあってからも、恋に関しては恥ずかしがりで、仲間からよくからかわれている。
ヒバリ校的2年生。天体观测爱好社团（天クル）的副部长。
洋的同班同学兼同桌。
开朗而精力过人的爱搞热闹的人。因为这种性格而被任命为班长。
因为有着与别人说话时就把脸凑过去的习惯，所以总是让洋感到坐立不安。
但是，对爱情方面却是感到相当的难为情，因此经常被朋友拿这方面的事情来戏弄。
家里经营着咖啡店『ミルキーウェイ』。很迷星星，连菜单都是星座的神话。
Likes: Hibarigasaki's starry sky
Dislikes: First-time partner

A mysterious girl who appeared in the lookout where You made a promise with a girl in his past. She calls herself a shinigami who can reap only peoples' nightmares. "Mare S. Ephemeral" is her Shinigami name, and her real name is unknown. She gets annoyed easily and tends to forget names quickly, but is also quite shy when she meets new people.

Mare is actually the same as Ren: she is a spirit of her respective meteorite. Mare is the meteorite that fell down on the day You left to the city and Yume was admitted to the hospital, and thought it to be a shooting star, so they both wished upon it. Her whereabouts are unknown, and this proves to be a difficult task for You and Yume who are supposed to find it after Mare sacrifices herself.
Her reincarnated name is Kogasaka Mea / 小河坂 芽愛
展望台によく現れる、自称死神。
洋とは新しい約束を交わしている。
内容は、洋のお嫁さんになるというもの。
約束に関しては洋と少し認識の違いがある。
そんな二人の仲はいつまでも続くと思われたが、ひとりの巫女の出現によって転機を迎える。
外表老成冰山，其实是个爱哭鬼。
超喜欢星星，总是出现在小城的展望台上。
拿着大镰刀自称死神，但据称并不收割人命而收割人的恶梦。
跟洋童年分开了的青梅竹马的样子非常相似。
究竟这里有什么理由呢，又或者是她跟那青梅竹马有什么关系呢，メア她都一直不愿开口。
Likes: Kosame
Dislikes: The stars

The elder of the Hisakaki twins and a member of the student council. She tends to have a tsundere personality and hates being called by her first name because it sounds "cute". Komomo gets flustered and embarrassed very, very easily which makes her an easy target for Kosame to tease and flirt with in public. Whenever she gets annoyed or flustered she tends to kick people (in You's case) or break their possessions with her kicks (in Asuka and Okaizumi's case).

In the beginning she tries to get the Astro Circle abolished, and wants You to join the student council. She often gets into arguments with Asuho due to this. She is a shrine maiden at the Seitengu, which worships a hoshigami (star god). For unknown reasons, Komomo can't stand the stars and dislikes the lookout.
こさめの双子の姉であり、生徒会役員を務めている。
家は星天宮という名の神社で、巫女の姿で仕事をしていることがある。
気が強く、不機嫌そうにしていることも多いが、根は生真面目でとても誠実。
自分の名前にコンプレックスを抱いていて、名前で呼ばれることを苦手にしている。
ヒバリ校的2年生。こさめ的孪生姐姐，学生会的成员。
家住名为星天宮的神社。有时会看见她穿着巫女装打水。
非常强气，一直脸带怒容，其实是个天生正经而诚实的女生。
不爽自己的名字，叫她名字的话她会超级生气。
超讨厌星星。仇视天クル，跟明日歩的吵架不绝于耳。
Likes: Her twin sister
Dislikes: To be snooped inadvertently

The younger of the Hisakaki twins and You's classmate. Kosame likes to tease her friends but at the same time, keeps a lot of secrets. She has a calm and mysterious personality and often randomly takes sides in arguments. Like her sister, she is also a shrine maiden. Despite her habit of constantly teasing her elder sister, Kosame is actually weak to being teased herself.
こももの双子の妹で、同じく星天宮の巫女を務めている。
こももとは正反対で誰に対しても物腰が柔らかく、仲間内のフォロー役を務めているが、そのフォローがさらに問題を悪化させる場合もしばしば。
満月を苦手にしており、その日は部屋に閉じこもってしまい、自分の姿を誰にも見せたがらない。
ヒバリ校的2年生。こもも的孪生妹妹、天クル的部员。跟姐姐こもも一起是星天宮的巫女。
跟こもも性格相反，无论是谁都平易近人，在社团之中是个和事佬，但也不时会让事情变得更加糟糕。
同时也担任着被朋友戏弄的角色。
与亲人雪菜关系良好，总是担心着不参与天クル活动的她。
Likes: Tarot cards
Dislikes: Making friends
Isuzu is a first year at Hibari High and Chinami and You's neighbor. She spends most of her time doing "Star Divination" by using her Tarot cards which she always carries around with her.

Isuzu is very antisocial and incredibly hard to please. She almost never approaches people and dislikes making friends even more. Initially, she tends to get annoyed when You and Chinami try to approach her, and often brushes them off with rude comments such as "You're annoying" and "Please jump off a bridge". However, she does warm up to them.
幼少期にオーストラリアに住んでいたため、南天の星空が大好き。
おとなしい性格だが、口を開くと激しく毒舌。
人付き合いが苦手で、孤独を好んでいたが、洋との出会いでそれも徐々に変わりつつある。
今では天クルの一員として、熱心に部活に参加している。
ヒバリ校的1年生。
对占星术有很深的研究，在学校里一直拿着塔罗牌。
性格老实，但一开口就是辛辣之语。
拒绝跟别人沟通，只会对妹妹鈴葉温柔。
对于同班同学千波，就算很严厉地叫她滚一边去，但是因为千波的性格不爱认输，总是将她的话当是耳边风。
You's childhood friend whom he met at the lookout seven years prior to the story. They made a promise that they would see each other again and get married.
She has an illness that caused her to be sent to the city for treatment, however she returned to Hibarigasaki years later.

When reuniting with You, she initially pretends she hasn't met him before and that she hasn't been in Hibarigasaki prior to moving back; she wanted You to forget about her since she was due to die soon because of her illness.
In Yume After, she gains a new ailas Kogasaka Yume / "小河坂 夢"
洋の恋人。
病気は快方に向かい、退院して洋の家で暮らしている。
お姉さんぶるのは相変わらずだが、家事は初心者。
ただ今、必死に勉強中。
目標は、自分の料理で洋をぎゃふんと言わせること。
洋的恋人。
病情好转，退院后住在洋的家里。
依旧在装大姐姐，初次做家务事。现在正努力地学习。
目标是自己的料理让洋赞口不绝。
「喜欢你哦，洋君。我不会再放手了哦」
A paper member of the Astronomy Club and a third-year student.
She is a shrine maiden who was dispatched to Hibarigasaki to send off Kosame.
ヒバリ校の３年生。
伊麻と同じく、こさめを送り還すために派遣されてきた星天宮の巫女。
だが現在は、友人としてこさめの護衛役を務めている。
伊麻を退けているのは、星天宮きっての武闘派である彼女の力量による。
ヒバリ校的3年生。姫榊姐妹的亲人。
天クル的幽灵部员，几乎不参与活动。
冰山而神秘，口吻也很冷淡，感情起伏不大。

A mysterious girl whose existence is similar to Mare's. For some reason, she looks over Chinami and sometimes even does her homework. Chinami calls her "Fairy-san". She is easily amused, but gets embarrassed when somebody pats her head.
Ren is actually a grim reaper from another world just like Mare, and Taiga's partner. She also hung around Tenkuru's members when Mayaka, Souichirou and Shino were part of it.
いつも大河のそばにいる、恋の死神。
ダメ人間フェチの彼女は、基本的にダメ人間の前にしか現れない。
そのため、千波とは大の仲良し。
雲雀ヶ崎の星霊とも交流を持ち、他界している洋の母親とも何度か会っているようだ。
一直在大河身边的、恋之死神。
废柴控的她基本只会出现在废柴前面。因此与千波关系相当好。
与雲雀ヶ崎的星霊们保持着交流，曾与去了他界的洋的母亲见过几面。

You's biological father. He met You's mother, Kogasaka Kasumi, when she was in middle school and fell in love at first sight. He then became a teacher at Kasumi's high school to get closer to her but was devastated to find out that she had a boyfriend already.

Later on when Kasumi's memories of her boyfriend were wiped by Ren, she became close to Taiga and had their son You. Kasumi would soon after regain her memories and leave Taiga. He is also the old director of Hibarigasaki's planetarium, and the one who gave Isuzu her telescope.
Taiga is a teacher working at Hibarikou who has stage fright.
Chinami and You's mother who died before the start of the game. Her death affected both of them very hard; especially You, who always stayed at home to help her out.
Likes: Peaceful life
Dislikes: Mayonnaise

You is the protagonist of the Hoshimemo series. After years of living in the city he and his little sister Chinami return to their hometown because of their mother's sudden death. He seemingly remembers a promise he once made with a girl before he moved away and now he wishes to meet her once again, if he can.
Mare's baby pet dragon whom she discovered at the lookout. It usually rests on Mare's head, but when she gets angry, he start shooting flames at You, even if he's not the one who made her angry.
Hisakaki twins' father and the owner of the hospital.

An honor and third-year student who is also the Astro Circle's president and likes puzzles. He tends to yell whenever he gets too excited, which always frightens Komomo and results to the Astro Circle members handing him his puzzle rings in order to calm him down.
The head shrine priestess and Komomo and Kosame's mother. She used to be a delinquent in the past.
She was a member of the Astro Club back during her high school days.

A second year at Hibari High and You's classmate. He is the sole member of the Occult Circle until he effortlessly succeeds in recruiting Chinami. He often gets into disagreements with Asuho. He has a tendency to take pictures of Kosame flirting with Komomo, and when he brags about it to You, Komomo crushes his camera under her foot.
He later tells You about his sister that went missing years ago.
You and Chinami's aunt who takes care of them after her sister dies. She works as an picture book artist, and spends most of her time working locked up in her room.
She was a member of the Astronomy Club when she was in school. She is unable to have any children.
Asuho's father and the owner of the cafe Milky Way.
He was the president of Tenkuru during the time when Shino and Mayaka were also members.
Isuzu's younger sister. She is very shy around strangers, and has a weak body. Due to this, she often gets fevers.
Yume's "fairy" tutor
and Chinami's late father. He died from a terminal illness and returned as a ghost, and is the boy in Hibari High's urban legend
The nurse in charge of Yume's ward.
